articles.title: How Banks Can Appease Trump on Credit-Card Rates
articles.mainIdea: How Banks Can Appease Trump on Credit-Card Rates
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: How Banks Can Appease Trump on Credit-Card Rates. President Trump reiterated his desire for a credit-card interest rate cap this week. Major card lenders American Express Capital One Financial Citigroup JPMorgan Chase and Synchrony Financial are all down this year. Goldman Sachs which has just exited a card business, has gained more than 8% so far this year. Related tickers mentioned: AXP, COF, ^GSPC.
